anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: He took down the power of death.
He preached to the spirits in prison.
LXX 23:7 quoted: lift up gates… the king of glory will come in.

choices.why: Christ overpasses the bounds Adam's disobedience had set.

pass_a_gloss: For the one having gone over the divine bounds through the disobedience in Adam, this one is Lord, who blunted the sting of death and took down its power, having given a leaping-over through good-news to the spirits guarded in Hades, and otherwise also having provided an upward road of travel into heaven through his own going-up, doors and gates being lifted through his entrance: Lift gates, you rulers of yours, and be lifted, everlasting gates, and the king of the glory will come in.
pass_b_english: For the one who has gone over the divine bounds — the bounds that were there through the disobedience in Adam — this one is Lord, who blunted the sting of death and took down its power, having given a leaping-over through good news to the spirits kept in Hades, and otherwise also having provided an upward road of travel into heaven through his own going up, doors and gates being lifted for his entrance: "Lift up gates, you rulers of yours, and be lifted, everlasting gates, and the king of glory will come in."
source_text: Ὁ γὰρ ὑπερβὰς τοὺς ὅρους τοὺς θείους διὰ τὴν ἐν Ἀδὰμ παρακοὴν οὗτός ἐστιν κ(ύριο)ς ὁ τοῦ|| θανάτου τὸ κέντρον ἀμβλύνας καὶ τὴν δύναμιν αὐτοῦ καθαιρήσας, δοὺς ὑπερπήδησιν δι’ εὐαγγελισμοῦ τοῖς ἐν ᾅδου φρουρηθεῖσιν πν(εύμα)σιν, ἄλλως δὲ καὶ ἄνοδον πορείας εἰς οὐ(ρα)νὸν παρασχόμενος διὰ τῆς αὐτοῦ ἀνόδου, θυρῶν καὶ πυλῶν ἐπαιρομένων διὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ εἴσοδον· "Ἄρατε πύλας οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐπάρθητε πύλαι αἰώνιοι, καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης".
